changes: The input is read in the audio interrupt, 1,500 times a second, and an action plays on the UI task as soon as a panel key would, instead of from stock's smoothed level once a UI tick (up to about 80 ms late); a 10 ms quiet time after each edge takes a footswitch's bounce, the bars' line follows the actions, and changing the levels or REVERSE DIRECTION no longer plays an action.
stockPolicy: No firmware or stock-derived code/tables are present. Addresses, lengths and SHA-256 guards are metadata; exported instructions and sections are authored module code. Local materialized recipes and firmware are never committed.
